notes.title: Episode version 24
notes.content:
Two main changes in this update:

[list]
[*] Accessibility settings (no shakes, no flashes, no scrolling) in Options → Gameplay. 
[*] “Cheat” unlockables (infinite lives, infinite missiles, infinite weapon power). Note that these unlockables come with a hefty score penalty, and while activated they also block specific medals.
[/list]

Any mid-mission progress as well as all Options menus will be lost.

notes.title: Episode update v.20
notes.content:
This is a small update to the Episode which:

[list]
[*] Adds a loading screen (to fix the stuttering caused by the initial asset preload). Pro tip: you can still press ESC to skip the loading screen (although of course the loading will still continue in the background, potentially causing stutters for a few seconds).
[*] Adds the "automatic" option for letterboxing (which will stretch up to 20%, then letterbox beyond that).
[/list]
Due to changes to some internal files, this update will regrettably reset any in-progress mission, and also any Options relating to Graphics/Sound/Controls/etc.

notes.title: Episode 5 Update
notes.content:
[h1]EPISODE 5[/h1]

This is a free major update which introduces the new "Episode" format: a fundamental rework of the game incorporating several significant and far-reaching enhancements:

[list]
[*] [b]Remastered graphics[/b]. Now in glorious Full HD 1920x1080 (16:9), rather than the original 1600x960 (5:3). Each wave, cutscene, and menu has been individually reviewed and tweaked to account for the new aspect ratio and screen dimensions.

[*] [b]Improved weapons[/b]. The weapon roster has been reworked and rebalanced. This is the cumulative result of a large player community effort to make all weapons equally effective and fun to use.

[*] [b]New engine[/b]. More display options, more visual effects, better customization for controls, plays nicer with recent versions of Windows. 

[*] [b]More languages[/b]. This is the result of another player community effort to translate the game to their native language. This project is still ongoing, so expect to see improved translations (or even new languages) over the coming updates.

[*] [b]Built-in seasonal content[/b]. Your progress (career stats, unlockables, mission progress) is now unified across all seasons.

[*] [b]Endless mode[/b].
[/list]

A slew of exciting features have also been back-ported from [b]Chicken Invaders Universe[/b] and made available in this update:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510460

[list]
[*] [b]New weapons[/b]

[*] [b]New special weapons[/b]

[*] [b]Boosters[/b]

[*] [b]6 skill levels[/b] (doubled from the original 3)

[*] [b]Custom cuisines[/b]

[*] [b]Hot, frozen, electric, massive, and darkness environments[/b]
[/list]

There is even support for exporting your purchase into [b]Chicken Invaders Universe[/b] for free! More on that below.

[h1]HOW TO PLAY THE UPDATE[/h1]

The Episode comes as a separate launch option when you click "Play" in your Steam Library.

If you are using a desktop shortcut to launch the game, note that the shortcut Steam creates can only start the game using the default launch option. Sadly, there is no way to launch the Episode directly, however you can force the launch options dialog to be displayed each time the shortcut is clicked.

Right-click on your desktop shortcut, and select "[b]Properties[/b]". Replace the URL field with this: [code]steam://launch/353090/dialog[/code]

[h1]ORIGINAL GAME[/h1]

The original game format is still available to play. Although the Episode has most of the features of the original (and a lot more besides), there are still some scenarios where you might prefer to play the original: 

[list]
[*] You like playing using the old mechanics, and the old game balance. Forks forever!

[*] You want to play a two-player game on the same PC.

[*] You want LAN/internet multiplayer functionality. For this, you should export your account to [b]Chicken Invaders Universe[/b] (see below for instructions). Even so, the original uses Steam relay servers, which allows it connect even under certain uncommon network scenarios where [b]Chicken Invaders Universe[/b] cannot.

[*] You keep track of Steam achievements and leaderboards.

[*] You want to play on Mac or Linux natively.

[*] Purely for familiarity and nostalgia reasons.
[/list]

[h1]HOW TO EXPORT TO CHICKEN INVADERS UNIVERSE (CIU)[/h1]

Prerequisites:

[list]
[*] Download [b]CIU[/b] from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510460]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510460[/url] . It's free!
	
[*] You must already have a [b]CIU[/b] account, and that account must be associated with an e-mail.

[*] You must own [b]Chicken Invaders 5[/b] on Steam yourself (that is, it must be purchased under the same account that you've used to log in to Steam). Steam Cafe or Family sharing [b]do not count [/b]as owning the game.
[/list]

Steps:

[list]
[*] At the main menu of [b]Chicken Invaders 5[/b], select "[b]Options[/b]" then "[b]Accounts[/b]".

[*] Select "[b]Export Purchase[/b]".

[*] Enter your [b]CIU[/b] account e-mail and click Submit.

[*] Done.
[/list]

Now log into [b]CIU[/b] to receive your DLC!

notes.title: Chicken Invaders Soundtrack now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39760645/fe4acd8b74f44b596886239532a24444f30717a2.png[/img]

The Chicken Invaders Soundtrack has been released! Get it now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248460/Chicken_Invaders_Soundtrack

[h1]-25% for the first week![/h1]

You've heard it before. It's always been in the background, fanning your sense of heroism, making you sweat in nail-biting tension, spurring you on to a chicken-blasting frenzy... And now you can enjoy it whenever you please!

This quadruple soundtrack album contains all music from Chicken Invaders: [b]Revenge of the Yolk[/b], [b]Ultimate Omelette[/b], [b]Cluck of the Dark Side[/b], and [b]Universe[/b]. It's a big and intricate orchestral score, composed and produced by wonderfully talented 2dB Music Production.

Sit back, relax, and re-live your greatest chicken-hunting moments by listening to the full-length tracks, or enjoy the small jingles as ringtones for your mobile phone.

As Bob Mandel, senior writer for the online magazine Adrenaline Vault writes: "[b]This is the most rousing, energizing, inspirational orchestral game soundtrack I have heard in many a year — in both virtual and real environments, it makes me feel as if I can overcome any obstacle !!!!!!![/b]"

tags.feature: The Chicken Invaders Soundtrack has been released! Get it now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248460/Chicken_Invaders_Soundtrack

notes.title: November 2021 update
notes.content:
[b]Windows[/b]: This update fixes certain translations and other minor cosmetic issues.

[b]Mac[/b]: This update ensures compatibility with macOS 12 Monterey, and also fixes a sound issue (namely, no sound at all) under certain circumstances.

[b]Linux[/b]: As a reminder, we have recently discontinued all Linux games due to insufficient market interest and increasing maintenance costs. The recommended way to play this game now is through Steam's Proton: right-click on the game in your Library, select "Properties", then "Compatibility", and force one of the Proton versions there.

notes.title: Chicken Invaders 5 Update
notes.content:
Today we released an update for Chicken Invaders 5. Apart from minor improvements, it adds language support for: English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Czech, and Russian.

Note: We have made changes to the way the game is launched under Mac and Linux, so this update is [b]mandatory[/b] for those platforms.

notes.title: Update: More joystick goodness!
notes.content:
The update released today (v5.04b) improves on last week's update with regards to joystick control. Menus can now more easily be navigated with the D-Pad and the "B" button to go back, and cutscenes can be skipped altogether by pressing the 'menu' button (configurable in Options).

[b]Your user data is fully upgradeable from the previous update.[/b]

Note: If you lost your highscores in the previous update and want to recover them, follow these steps:
[olist]
[*] Disconnect the game from the Steam Cloud (Right-click on game in your Library > Properties > Update > Uncheck "Steam cloud")
[*] Explore to [Steam-Folder] > userdata > [Steam User ID] > 353090 > remote > steamcloud > CI5 > 5.04steam
[*] Delete the file CI5.hst
[*] Run the game
[*] Once you verify that scores have been upgraded correctly, re-connect the game to the Steam Cloud
[/olist]
